desc: Ideation: define state, recurrence, and clockwise direction mapping (DR->DL->UL->UR->DR).
Implement iterative DP: T[d][i][j] (no-turn alternating run) and F[d][i][j] (at most one clockwise turn), with value rule nxt = 2 if v!=2 else 0.
Filter answer to cells with grid value 1 (correct greedy brute forces embedded).
Run the full harness: examples (5,4,5,1), 15 edge cases, 2000 random (n,m<=6) vs brute_greedy, 400 random (n,m<=5) vs two brutes, 300 planted-segment grids — all report 0 mismatches / ALL OK.
Verified correctness against two independent brute-force implementations and hand-verified edge facts; complexity O(n*m) time and memory, fits n,m<=500.
